findings.finding: NEC's Q1 deck states that CSG's newly consolidated results were NOT in the 7/29 FY guide (revenue 3,540bn, Non-GAAP OP 430bn) and will be built in at the H1 release, so a mechanical upward revision on revenue is pre-committed; Q1 data imply CSG adds about 13.7bn yen of revenue a month but little Non-GAAP OP (pro-forma OP 74.0bn vs reported 74.7bn; overseas IT OP +3.6bn on +45.6bn revenue).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises at 2025-10-29 (H1, Non-GAAP OP 320->340bn) moved about +13.2%, at 2026-07-29 (Q1, 420->430bn) about +8.4%; the 2026-01-29 raise moved about -5.9% (baseline cadence history, dates matched to TDnet/kabutan release dates).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the deck says it in a headline line, so the revenue raise is known. What is not visible is how much Non-GAAP OP CSG adds; the Q1 numbers suggest little, so a large revenue raise with a small OP raise is the likely shape and a reader anchored on the revenue headline could be disappointed or relieved by the OP line. If the market had a precise CSG OP number the consensus would already sit on the Non-GAAP line; IFIS carries only ordinary profit.
findings.independence: Same document as the progress-rate finding below (one deck, two different facts: CSG fold-in vs organic progress). Consolidation of CSG and 46 subsidiaries also confirmed in the Q1 tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501413.pdf

findings.finding: Q1 Non-GAAP OP of 74.7bn yen is 17.4% of the 430bn FY guide, against 40.0bn in Q1 last year (12.5% of that year's 320bn initial guide, 10.1% of the 397.2bn actual), and NEC has raised its FY profit guide at each of its last three prints (2025-10-29, 2026-01-29, 2026-07-29), so an organic raise beyond the CSG fold-in is likely at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line as above: H1 raise in 2025 +13.2%, Q1 raise 2026 +8.4%, Q3 raise 2026-01 -5.9%; the FY initial guide on 2026-04-28 (420bn) moved -7.7%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-28 (page fetched; revision history 25/10/29 修, 26/01/29 修, 26/07/29 修; quarterly figures 26.04-06)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: anyone can compute the progress rate from the 7/29 deck and the stock is up 12.7% in 20 days with IFIS consensus ordinary profit +11.6% y/y, above what the company's own guide implies. What is left is the size of the organic raise, which nobody can see until the release; if the market had fully priced a large raise the consensus would not have been trimmed 0.5% the week before the print.
findings.independence: Guide and Q1 figures from the 7/29 deck https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501452.pdf (shares a document with finding 1); revision record from kabutan; IT-services demand read-through: Nikkei reports NRI at a year high after IBM beat https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOFL221IY0S6A021C2000000/

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print crowded long: 20-day run-up +12.66%, margin long/short ratio 9.22x, zero disclosed shorts, IFIS rating 4.8 strong buy with a target 20% above spot, and a 2026-10-21 kabutan piece calling NEC immune to the AI sell-off as a SpaceX-rival space/defense name.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After a run into results, the 2026-01-29 raise sold -5.9% and the 2026-04-28 FY guide -7.7%; after the July run-up from about 4,400 yen the Q1 raise still rose +8.4%. Mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself, so it is a statement about the reaction function rather than unpriced information: a crowded margin long is the one setup in which an in-line raise still has sellers. It largely agrees with the baseline's priced lean (-1.1), which is why it is sized small.
